As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

CrowdStrike Cloud Workload Protection places security controls at the level of individual application workloads. It enables organizations to identify and remediate vulnerabilities across the application lifecycle, enforcing compliance and security best practices across containers, Kubernetes and any workload. We also build security tools into the earliest phases of the development process, so vulnerable code is identified as it is written rather than in testing, which reduces costs and results in more secure applications.

Our engineers work with AI coding agents every day. We're looking for people who can use these tools to move fast while bringing the judgment, depth and ownership that keep production systems correct and secure.

This role is hybrid, requiring a minimum of 3 days per week on-site from our New York City office.

What You’ll Do:

Contribute to and lead backend engineering efforts, from rapid prototypes to large-scale services across CrowdStrike's cloud security products.
Design, build, test, deploy and operate large-scale distributed services. Use AI coding agents to speed up delivery, while staying fully accountable for the correctness, security and maintainability of everything you ship.
Turn product requirements into clear technical designs and well-scoped tasks that both engineers and AI agents can carry out reliably.
Review code with a critical eye, whether a person or an agent wrote it. Catch logic errors, performance problems, insecure patterns and unnecessary complexity.
Build and maintain the guardrails that make fast, AI-assisted development safe: strong test suites, CI checks, static analysis, observability and clear repository documentation and conventions.
Triage and debug production issues across distributed systems, using AI tools to speed up investigation while applying your own judgment about root cause and impact.
Build public-facing command-line tools, some of which interact with our web services.
Mentor other engineers on our services, engineering best practices, and effective and responsible use of AI development tools.
Work with cross-functional teams across geographies, and partner with Product to define requirements and deliver features.
Respond to customer-reported issues quickly and take ownership through to resolution.
Keep re-evaluating our architecture, test coverage, performance, observability and stability, including how our team's development workflows can improve as AI tooling evolves.
Ultimately, help build a platform that secures the entire lifecycle of cloud workloads for CrowdStrike customers.

What You’ll Need:

U.S. citizen or Permanent Resident and work solely from U.S. soil.
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
A solid understanding of distributed systems and scalability challenges. Sharding, partitioning and horizontal scaling are second nature to you.
Strong programming fundamentals in at least one statically typed language. We write Go; you can learn it on the job, but you should be able to read and judge Go code critically.
Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure or GCP, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep), and Docker/Kubernetes/Helm.
Experience with Kafka or a similar message queue (message design, sizing and rates, monitoring consumer lag) and with relational databases such as Postgres.
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Experience with, or strong interest in, AI-assisted development. You know how to give an agent the right context, when to trust its output, and when to step in and write or rewrite the code yourself.
Awareness of the risks that come with AI-generated code: invented or untrusted dependencies, secrets exposure, prompt injection, and insecure defaults.
Excellent code review skills, and a strong grasp of testing strategies that make correctness checkable rather than assumed.
Clear written communication. Design docs, task breakdowns and pull request descriptions are how you guide both your teammates and your tools.
A habit of owning outcomes: you meet commitments, you love seeing your code run in production, and you stand behind it when it breaks.

Understanding of cloud security concepts such as CSPM, CWPP and CNAPP.
Familiarity with container and Kubernetes security (build-time and runtime).
Exposure to cloud security products, including product direction for AI/ML, XDR, SIEM, SOAR or related cybersecurity domains.

Commission, tune, test, and troubleshoot HOLOPLOT systems on-site
Communicate professionally with venue teams, integrators, production crews, and internal colleagues

Document project learnings and contribute to workflow improvements and best practices

3–6 years of experience in professional audio, acoustics, system engineering, AV integration, or event technology

Who We Are And What You’ll Do

HOLOPLOT is redefining what's possible in professional audio. Our Matrix Array technology enables precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - a fundamentally new approach grounded in physics and realized through purpose-built hardware and software.

Our systems power some of the most ambitious audio installations in the world, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - currently the largest audio installation in entertainment.

The thoughtful integration of electroacoustic, DSP, control, and audio networking platforms will achieve a cohesive solution that meets the demanding technical and operational requirements of the venues we work with.

We're looking for a hands-on Application Engineer to support planning, commissioning, and optimization of HOLOPLOT systems across key US venues and projects.

The ideal candidate is

You are a high-energy, hands-on Application Engineer with experience in professional audio, acoustics, or sound system engineering. You have worked on loudspeaker systems in complex environments such as entertainment venues, theatres, arenas, or immersive audio spaces.

You are practical, technically curious, and confident in fast-moving on-site situations. Your experience may include system tuning, audio networking, signal flow, rigging coordination, venue operations, client-facing project work, demos, or technical training. You are excited by beamforming, spatial audio, and next-generation sound system design.

Main objectives of the role

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge audio technology and real-world project delivery — supporting system design, on-site commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer relationships for high-profile installations.

After a structured onboarding, you'll take ownership of defined work packages and represent HOLOPLOT independently at venues such as Radio City Music Hall, Sphere, and similar projects.

Core Responsibilities

Support system design and simulation using HOLOPLOT PLAN, proprietary tools, EASE, and similar software
Translate venue and client requirements into practical technical solutions
Prepare technical deliverables: simulation results, system proposals, measurement reports, stakeholder documentation
Commission, tune, test, and troubleshoot HOLOPLOT systems on-site
Communicate professionally with venue teams, integrators, production crews, and internal colleagues
Provide remote and on-site after-sales support including venue changes and new shows
Assist with product demos, training sessions, and partner education
Document project learnings and contribute to workflow improvements and best practices

What you need to succeed in this role

3–6 years of experience in professional audio, acoustics, system engineering, AV integration, or event technology
Hands-on experience planning, installing, testing, or commissioning loudspeaker systems in complex venues
Degree or equivalent practical background in acoustics, audio engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field
Working knowledge of acoustic simulation tools (EASE, CATT, or similar)
Experience with measurement tools (SMAART, EASERA, or comparable)
Familiarity with 3D drafting or CAD tools (SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD) is a plus
Strong problem-solving skills,comfort working in live venue and construction environments, and confidence in demanding customer-facing situations
Ability to work independently on defined tasks after onboarding
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
High energy, reliability, and a willingness to learn complex technology
Frequent (~25% on average, 50% in key project phases) travel within the US; occasional international travel
Fluency in English

We offer you

At HOLOPLOT, you’ll work on technology that is redefining professional audio, with direct impact on globally visible projects. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across applications, software, hardware, product, research, and project delivery, in an environment that offers a high degree of ownership, hands-on learning, and real growth opportunities.

For our US-based employees, we offer competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, financial security, and a productive work setup.

HOLOPLOT is a pro audio company from Berlin, Germany. Since early 2011, we have been working on radically transforming audio technology, by re-thinking the underlying physics of sound reproduction. We wondered: What if sound could truly be controlled the way we can control light? What if we could create soundscapes that feel more real than reality? What if every seat in a venue could be made the best seat?

Our solution is science-based, software-driven, and hardware-enabled: the HOLOPLOT Matrix Array. The sound system for a new era, a powerful tool that brings previously inaccessible capabilities to the world of audio. We believe when people experience better sound, they will enjoy more meaningful moments and create richer memories. At HOLOPLOT, it is our mission to redefine what is possible - enabling unparalleled and breathtaking experiences.
